Apple has launched a new health study app in the U.S. designed to explore how people use AI for health inquiries, partnering with OpenEvidence.

The year-long project targets up to 200,000 participants over 21 using recent iPhone hardware running iOS 26 or later with Apple Intelligence enabled.

Participants can share HealthKit metrics and clinical queries grounded in trusted medical sources.
